def search(lst):
    from collections import Counter
    count = Counter(lst)
    candidates = [num for num, freq in count.items() if freq >= num and num > 0]
    return max(candidates) if candidates else -1

    from collections import Counter
    freq = Counter(lst)
    candidates = [num for num in freq if freq[num] >= num]
    return max(candidates) if candidates else -1

def search(lst):
    from collections import Counter
    count = Counter(lst)
    valid_numbers = [num for num, freq in count.items() if freq >= num]
    return max(valid_numbers) if valid_numbers else -1
